p.src: 1  After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

en: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
u.src: 1  After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

p.src: 2  He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

en: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
u.src: 2  He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

p.src: 3  David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

en: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
u.src: 3  David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

p.src: 4  David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

en: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.
u.src: 4  David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

p.src: 5  When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

en: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
u.src: 5  When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

p.src: 6  Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
u.src: 6  Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

p.src: 7  David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

en: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
u.src: 7  David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

p.src: 8  From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

en: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
u.src: 8  From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

p.src: 9  When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
u.src: 9  When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

p.src: 10  then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

en: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

p.src: 11  King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

en: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—
u.src: 11  King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

p.src: 12  of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

en: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

p.src: 13  David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

en: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
